final: WITH combo_counts AS (SELECT transactionrecord.transreg, trader.tradekind, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM advancedbehavior JOIN transactionrecord ON advancedbehavior.translink = transactionrecord.transreg JOIN trader ON transactionrecord.trdref = trader.tradereg GROUP BY transactionrecord.transreg, trader.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as grand_total FROM combo_counts) SELECT combo_counts.tradekind, AVG(1.0 * combo_counts.cnt) as avg_count, AVG(100.0 * combo_counts.cnt / totals.grand_total) as avg_share FROM combo_counts, totals GROUP BY combo_counts.tradekind ORDER BY combo_counts.tradekind
